content: Altounyan, Altunyan, Altounian, and Altonian (Armenian: Ալթունյան; Western Armenian: Ալթունեան) is a common Armenian surname. It can refer to:
<info> Roger Altounyan (1922–1987), Anglo-Armenian physician and pharmacologist
<info> Essaï Altounian (born 1980), French-Armenian singer, songwriter, keyboardist, music producer and an actor
<info> Joe Altounian, American-Armenian entrepreneur and businessman
